steps.title: The right moment
steps.body: Right after the customer got what they wanted.

steps.title: A personal sender
steps.body: A named person, not a no-reply address.

steps.title: A specific hook
steps.body: Something they actually did or said.

steps.title: Prompts, not a blank box
steps.body: Two or three questions that make it easy.

steps.title: One link, one action
steps.body: No account, no login, no choosing sites.

name: post-trial-email
label: After a trial converts
subject: Quick question
body: Hi Sam, thanks for upgrading! I'm curious — what made you decide to go paid?
If you're up for it, your answer would make a great short testimonial for our site.
